description: Frozen current-work split proposal for the fairer LLM re-entry benchmark. Dev is allowed for prompt and protocol debugging. Holdout is reserved for the main claim. Stress is for edge-shape diagnostics and should not be mixed into the primary holdout score.
selection_rules: Exclude benchmark-maintenance work and sparse works.
Keep holdout diverse across active, done, artifact-heavy, docs-heavy, code-adjacent, and cross-repo shapes.
Use dev for tuning and protocol debugging only.
Use stress for edge-case analysis after the holdout protocol is frozen.
